description: Header file defining functions to create messages related to door lock events such as add, remove, and update, for communication with a server.

methods.name: createDoorLockAddedMessage
methods.description: Creates a message indicating a new door lock has been added.

methods.name: createDoorLockRemovedMessage
methods.description: Creates a message indicating a door lock has been removed.

methods.name: createDoorLockUpdatedMessage
methods.description: Creates a message indicating a door lock has been updated.
